title: 第16章 小聚
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
春波亭在岑山坊市三百里外，虽不算太远，却也要翻过几座山岭。

    五月山色正好，沿途草木葱茏，山风拂过，带着几分湿润水气。

    林玄与张百林用清风术赶路，半个时辰后，就看见前方山腰处出现一座小亭。

    那亭子建在一处临水高坡上，旁边有一条清溪蜿蜒而过，水声潺潺，春波微漾，倒也不负春波亭之名。

    远远望去，亭中已有一男一女两人对坐，似乎正在低声交谈。

    女子穿着一身浅白衣裙，衣袂随风轻动，身姿清雅。

    男子则是青衫打扮，面容俊秀。

    正是杨念雪与徐云。

    似是感应到了林玄二人的气息，亭中女子忽然转头看来。

    看清来人后，她眼睛微微一亮，随即起身，朝林玄与张百林这边含笑挥了挥手。

    徐云也转过头来，看向二人。

    不多时，林玄与张百林迈步走入亭中。

    四人落座，饮茶品茗一番后，徐云率先笑着向张百林抱怨道。

    “百林哥，你们两个可算来了。”

    “我和念雪在这里等了一个多时辰，还以为你们路上遇见什么麻烦了。”

    张百林哈哈一笑。

    “路上耽误了些功夫。”

    “再说了，约的是今日，又没约具体时辰，你小子自己来得早，怎么还怪起我们来了？”

    徐云笑着摇了摇头，目光却很快落在林玄身上。

    只是这一看，他脸上的笑意忽然一僵。

    与此同时，杨念雪也看向林玄。

    比起四年前分别时，她已然褪去了几分少女稚气。

    如今的杨念雪眉眼清秀，气质温婉，身上穿着青云宗外门弟子的浅白法衣，腰间悬着一只小巧丹葫。

    她双眸明亮，笑起来时如溪水映月，一如当年。

    只是此刻，她看着林玄，眼中也浮现出一抹惊喜。

    “林大哥，恭喜你突破炼气四层。”

    她声音轻柔，却带着真切喜意。

    说着，她取出两只白玉瓶，分别递给林玄和张百林，对林玄略有些无奈地笑了笑。

    “看来我准备的礼物，倒是有些不合时宜了。”

    “这是我亲手炼制的养元丹，每瓶三十枚。”

    “本想着林大哥若还在炼气三层，或许能派上些用处。”

    “如今看来，倒是有些小瞧林大哥了。”

    林玄看着她手中的白玉瓶，心中微微一动。

    三十枚养元丹。

    这么多丹药，对炼气初期的修士而言，已经算是一份不轻的礼物了。
content_en:
Chunbo Pavilion is three hundred miles away from Censhanfang City. Although it is not too far, it still has to climb several mountains.

    The mountains are beautiful in May, with lush vegetation along the way, and the mountain breeze blows with a bit of moisture.

    Lin Xuan and Zhang Bailin used Qingfeng Technique to rush forward. Half an hour later, they saw a small pavilion appearing on the mountainside ahead.

    The pavilion was built on a high slope near the water, with a clear stream winding past it. The water was gurgling and the spring waves were slightly rippling. It lived up to the name of the Chunbo Pavilion.

    Looking from a distance, a man and a woman were sitting opposite each other in the pavilion, seeming to be talking in a low voice.

    The woman is wearing a light white dress, her clothes are gently swaying in the wind, and her figure is elegant.

    The man is dressed in a green shirt and has a handsome face.

    It was Yang Nianxue and Xu Yun.

    As if sensing the auras of Lin Xuan and the others, the woman in the pavilion suddenly turned her head to look.

    After seeing the person clearly, her eyes lit up slightly, then she stood up and waved to Lin Xuan and Zhang Bailin with a smile.

    Xu Yun also turned his head and looked at the two of them.

    Not long after, Lin Xuan and Zhang Bailin walked into the pavilion.

    The four of them sat down and drank some tea. Xu Yun took the lead and complained to Zhang Bailin with a smile.

    "Brother Bai Lin, you two are here."

    "Nian Xue and I have been waiting here for more than an hour. We thought you might have encountered some trouble on the way."

    Zhang Bailin laughed.

    "I wasted some time on the way."

    "Besides, the appointment is today, and there is no specific time. You came early, so why are you blaming us?"

    Xu Yun smiled and shook his head, but his eyes quickly fell on Lin Xuan.

    Just at this look, the smile on his face suddenly froze.

    At the same time, Yang Nianxue also looked at Lin Xuan.

    Compared with when they separated four years ago, she has lost some of her girlishness.

    Today, Yang Nianxue has delicate features and a gentle temperament. He is wearing the light white robe of an outer disciple of the Qingyun Sect, with a small pill gourd hanging around his waist.

    Her eyes were bright, and when she smiled, she was like the moon reflected in the stream, just like before.

    But at this moment, when she looked at Lin Xuan, there was a hint of surprise in her eyes.

    "Brother Lin, congratulations on breaking through the fourth level of Qi refining."

    Her voice was soft, but filled with genuine joy.

    With that said, she took out two white jade bottles and handed them to Lin Xuan and Zhang Bailin respectively, and smiled helplessly at Lin Xuan.

    "It seems that the gift I prepared is a bit inappropriate."

    "This is the Yangyuan Pill that I personally refined. There are thirty pills in each bottle."

    "I thought that if Brother Lin was still on the third level of Qi Refining, he might be able to put it to some use."

    "Now it seems that I am looking down on Brother Lin."

    Lin Xuan looked at the white jade bottle in her hand, and his heart moved slightly.

    Thirty Yuan Yang Pills.

    So many elixirs are already a considerable gift for the monks who are in the early stage of Qi refining.
